answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a hardware-rooted attestation key whose enrollment requires burning a scarce physical resource, much as a forge consumes copper and timber to mint a stamped token. Peer attestation then samples each agent's key against a public registry, so duplicate or cloned identities collapse onto one weighted vote rather than. Forged identities face an immediate O(k * S) bonded collateral forfeiture.
